run_lottery_branch: run a lottery branch experiment using the BranchRunner meta-runner from the OpenLTH library
create_branch_runner_from_args: create a BranchRunner instance from argparse arguments using the create_from_args static method
add_branch_args_to_parser: add branch-specific CLI arguments to an argparse parser using the add_args static method
display_output_location: display the output location of a lottery branch experiment via the display_output_location method
get_branch_description: get the description text for the BranchRunner using the description static method
